context: The agent must add a new endpoint by pattern-matching onto a fully-specced sibling route, rather than needing to know the exact Reitit/Malli OpenAPI API from scratch. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may inline the response shape directly in the route (:responses {200 {:body [:map ...]}}), skip the security requirement, and skip the example, since Reitit will happily emit a spec without any of that; with the idiom loaded, it knows full OpenAPI 3.x compliance is the contract itself, so it registers a named, reusable schema, declares security explicitly, and includes an example, matching the sibling route.

checklist.name: Named, reusable response schema
checklist.description: A new ::widget (or similarly named) schema is registered in schemas.clj alongside ::account, and the route references it by key rather than inlining the shape

checklist.name: Security requirement declared
checklist.description: The new route declares the same api-key security requirement as the accounts route

checklist.name: Example included
checklist.description: The route or schema carries a realistic response example, matching the accounts route's convention

checklist.name: Route follows existing path/method convention
checklist.description: GET /v1/widgets/:id is added under the same route-vector shape as GET /v1/accounts/:id

checklist.name: Accounts route and schema left unchanged
checklist.description: The existing account route and ::account schema are not modified
